subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should the fix keep room_event visible delivery strict while stabilizing the prompt/cache prefix, or should explicit groupChat.visibleReplies automatic change room-event delivery semantics?
rationale: Current code, docs, and tests intentionally keep ambient room events quiet unless the message tool sends, but the reported prompt-cache churn is credible and the linked PR adds a related owner-only tool visibility boundary choice.

options.title: Stabilize Prompt, Keep Strict Delivery
options.body: Keep room_event visible output message-tool-only by default and move prompt/cache-visible differences below the stable prefix or through a prompt-facing mode.

options.title: Honor Automatic For Room Events
options.body: Let explicit groupChat.visibleReplies automatic make room_event final text visible, with privacy-focused docs and regression tests.

options.title: Document Strict Behavior Only
options.body: Accept the current strict behavior and document the prompt/cache tradeoff clearly for operators instead of changing runtime behavior.

recommendation.title: Stabilize Prompt, Keep Strict Delivery
recommendation.body: Keep room_event visible output message-tool-only by default and move prompt/cache-visible differences below the stable prefix or through a prompt-facing mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the group visible-reply and ambient-room policy history from the prior merged feature work.
